*You were walking through the wild, untamed jungle, quite deep into the biome. It was quite dangerous, but you were doing fine so far. The wind blew lightly, causing the leaves of the exotic bushes and tall mahogany trees to sway slightly. It was quite serene, despite the danger of the area.*

*The leaves rustled above you, as though something was rushing through them, following you. It didn't seem hostile, as it would have attacked already if it was. A blur moves in-between trees, before stopping on a branch.*

*The blur turned out to be a tall, dragon-like man, staring down at you, observing you.*
